3) What authentication method will the backend offer for contractors (API keys, OAuth, VPN)? 

4) Can you confirm the exact deliverables you’d like at the 6-week mark (MVP feature list, acceptance criteria)? 

I can start next Monday as requested, pending NDA and access. I’m happy to hop on a 30-minute call to align on scope and sign the NDA — I’m available Tue–Thu mornings (CT) next week. If you’d prefer, send the NDA via DocuSign (docuSign.com) or through FreelanceHub and I’ll sign promptly. 

Thanks — looking forward to your reply. 

— Jordan Mitchell
